findings.location: Paragraph about Acts 19 (the 'Great is Diana' quote)
findings.source_quote: Great is Diana of the Ephesians
findings.suggested_fix: The translator rendered the quoted phrase in Koine Greek («Μέγα εστὶ τὴν Διὰνάν τὴν Ἐφέσων»). The project requested contemporary Modern Greek. Render the quoted exclamation into Modern Greek idiom while preserving the quoted-prose status and meaning. For example: «Η Διάνα των Εφέσων είναι μεγάλη» or a closer exclamatory Modern Greek rendering «Μεγάλη είναι η Διάνα των Εφεσίων». Keep the quotation marks and place the translated quote exactly where the English quote appears in the source.
